reviews.title: One of the best apps
reviews.text:
I used many apps before but I found this app a good tool when chatting with groups of other religion, it is amazing when I try look for a verse in the holy Quran in Arabic and translate it to any language in seconds or when I explain an Ayah or a Surah, you have choices of many Muslim schoolers like Ibnou Kathir, Al Tabari, Al kortobey..I advice all my friends and all Muslims to buy it. 

I wish one day I can copy and paste verses, it will help a lot when chatting with no Muslims on social media 

Thank you.
Every time I want to use the app it ask me to rate the app, ands ask other questions
